name: @trailboard/server
description: Yjs WebSocket sync server for Trailboard boards

comments.overrides: y-websocket 1.5.x declares y-leveldb@0.1.x, which drags in the deprecated native leveldown build. We never load it (we install our own persistence via setPersistence instead of the YPERSISTENCE env var), so we pin the whole tree to y-leveldb 0.2 / classic-level.
